metric_name: 能源使用效益目标设定与行动方案
query: 能源使用效益目标设定与行动方案 能源使用效益目标设定与行动方案 衡量企业是否建立了明确的能源使用效益目标（如节电量、能效提升百分比等），以及是否披露了实现上述目标的具体执行路径、技术手段及资源投入。重点考察目标的科学性（是否有时间表）、具体性（是否有量化值）及可落地性（是否有配套步骤）。 A. 目标设定得分 (权重 50%） 2分：披露了明确的量化目标、基准年及达标年份。 1分：仅有描述性或愿景式目标（如“努力节能”），无具体量效指标。 0分：未提及任何能源效益目标。 B. 执行方案得分 (权重 50%) 2分：详细披露了为实现目标所采取的技术改造、管理优化或可再生能源替代的具体步骤。 1分：仅笼统提及将采取措施，缺乏具体行动描述。 0分：无行动方案。 最终得分 = 0.5×目标设定得分+0.5×执行方案得分 能源效益目标 能效提升目标 节电目标 节能计划 能源管理体系 节能改造 可再生能源替代 能源绩效改进 ISO 50001 energy efficiency target energy intensity reduction electricity saving target energy conservation plan energy management system retrofit programme renewable energy substitution energy performance improvement ISO 50001 企业是否披露量化或定性的能源效益、节电或能效提升目标？ 量化目标的指标值、基准年与达标年份是什么？ 为实现目标采取了哪些技术改造、管理优化或可再生能源替代步骤？ 是否披露具体实施路径或资源投入？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '能源使用效益目标设定与行动方案'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否披露量化或定性的能源效益、节电或能效提升目标？ 量化目标的指标值、基准年与达标年份是什么？ 为实现目标采取了哪些技术改造、管理优化或可再生能源替代步骤？ 是否披露具体实施路径或资源投入？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有温室气体减排目标且无能源效益目标或行动；仅有能源消耗披露且无目标或行动；仅有历史节能绩效且无前瞻目标或行动。不得排除“努力节能”等定性目标、笼统执行意向，或未与目标显式绑定的具体能效措施：它们可分别支持目标设定或执行方案的低档/高档证据。区分：本指标分别评价能源效益目标和执行方案；温室气体减排目标不能自动替代能源效益目标。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: In response to the China's 30-60 Decarbonization Goal (China strives to peak carbon dioxide emissions by 2030 and achieve carbon neutrality by 2060), we earnestly implement the national policy of energy conservation and emission reduction. In 2021, we formulated the Work Instructions for Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction to standardize the management of energy conservation and emission reduction. In daily operation, we advocate green office and save water, electricity and paper to reduce carbon emissions. Upon carbon emissions verification, performance and asset management for projects in Beijing, we registered an annual balance of 4,269.3 tons of carbon assets, contributing our share to carbon reduction.

[Content]
In response to the China's 30-60 Decarbonization Goal (China strives to peak carbon dioxide emissions by 2030 and achieve carbon neutrality by 2060), we earnestly implement the national policy of energy conservation and emission reduction. In 2021, we formulated the Work Instructions for Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction to standardize the management of energy conservation and emission reduction. In daily operation, we advocate green office and save water, electricity and paper to reduce carbon emissions. Upon carbon emissions verification, performance and asset management for projects in Beijing, we registered an annual balance of 4,269.3 tons of carbon assets, contributing our share to carbon reduction.

[Content]
2021 marked the start of the 14th Five-Year Plan and the Second Centaury goal and bears great significance on Jinmao Services. This year, we were officially renamed "Jinmao Services" and our brand philosophy was also refreshed to embark on a new journey. In this year, we continued to improve our performance in environmental protection, employee care, partnership and community support to keep up with people's ever-growing needs for a better life.
